facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's EMRS implementation guidelines, published 18 September 2024, name the Ministry as owner, its Division of Health Information Management as coordinator of public-sector design and development, and the national Ministry team as system administrator, with local governments leading implementation in districts and cities.

The Ministry of Health's guidelines of 18 September 2024 set a framework for implementing the EMRS nationwide in all public and private health facilities, aligned with the Uganda Health Information and Digital Health Strategic Plan 2020/21-2024/25 and to be reviewed annually.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Division of Health Information Management
systems.tiers: Intended for all service delivery points in public and private health facilities; guidelines require patient registration with a unique identifier and longitudinal tracking of services
